exists.quote: The governor shall appoint a North Dakota board of medicine consisting of fifteen members; ten physicians, nine of whom are doctors of medicine and one of whom is a doctor of osteopathy; two physician assistants; one naturopath; and two public members.

national_certification.value: Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG)

national_association.value: American Board of Medical Specialties; Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada; American Osteopathic Association
national_association.quote: The board may accept current certification, maintenance of certification, or recertification by a member of the American board of medical specialties, the American osteopathic association, or the royal college of physician and surgeons of Canada in lieu of compliance with continuing education requirements.

regulatory_model.quote: No person may engage in the practice of medicine in this state without a current license issued by the board.

credential_type.quote: No person may engage in the practice of medicine in this state without a current license issued by the board.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may engage in the practice of medicine in this state without a current license issued by the board.

title_protection.quote: An individual not licensed as a physician or resident physician under this chapter is prohibited from using the title of "doctor of medicine", "medical doctor", "doctor of osteopathic medicine", "osteopathic physician", "physician", "M.D.", or "D.O.".

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices medicine in this state without complying with the provisions of this chapter, and any person who violates any of the provisions of this chapter for which another penalty is not specified is guilty of a class B misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, fraudulent, or forged statements or documents in connection with licensing requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document, or the use of any fraudulent, deceitful, dishonest, or immoral practice, in connection with any of the licensing requirements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading statements about the physician's skill or the efficacy of any medicine, treatment, or remedy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The making of false or misleading statements about the physician's skill or the efficacy of any medicine, treatment, or remedy.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a misdemeanor with direct bearing on ability to serve the public or any felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of any misdemeanor determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon a person's ability to serve the public as a practitioner of medicine or any felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of alcohol or drugs to a degree that interferes with the ability to safely practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of alcohol or drugs to such a degree as to interfere with the licensee's ability to safely practice medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental disability materially affecting the ability to perform duties as a physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental disability materially affecting the ability to perform the duties of a physician in a competent manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The performance of any dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by an unlicensed, incompetent, or impaired person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by an unlicensed, incompetent, or impaired person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of a medical practice act or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any provision of a medical practice act or the rules and regulations of the board, or any action, stipulation, condition, or agreement imposed by the board or its investigative panels.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of medicine under a false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of medicine under a false or assumed name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising for the practice of medicine in an untrue or deceptive manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The advertising for the practice of medicine in an untrue or deceptive manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition can be cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The representation to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition, sickness, disease, or injury can be cured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or negligent violation of physician-patient confidentiality
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The willful or negligent violation of the confidentiality between physician and patient, except as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a doctor of osteopathy to designate their school of practice in professional use of name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure of a doctor of osteopathy to designate that person's school of practice in the professional use of that person's name by such terms as "osteopathic physician and surgeon", "doctor of osteopathy", "D.O.", or similar terms.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual abuse, misconduct, or exploitation related to the licensee's practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sexual abuse, misconduct, or exploitation related to the licensee's practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, or giving controlled substances for non-therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The prescription, sale, administration, distribution, or gift of any drug legally classified as a controlled substance or as an addictive or dangerous drug for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Payment or receipt of fee, commission, rebate, or compensation for medical services not rendered or for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The payment or receipt, directly or indirectly, of any fee, commission, rebate, or other compensation for medical services not actually or personally rendered, or for patient referrals

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with reporting requirements of section 43-17.1-05.1
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to comply with the reporting requirements of section 43-17.1-05.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to transfer medical records or supply copies to patient or representative upon request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to transfer medical records to another physician or to supply copies of those records to the patient or to the patient's representative when requested to do so by the patient or the patient's designated representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued pattern of inappropriate care, including unnecessary surgery
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A continued pattern of inappropriate care as a physician, including unnecessary surgery.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in any document connected with the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in any document connected with the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, or giving controlled substances to oneself, spouse, or child
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, or giving to oneself or to one's spouse or child any drug legally classified as a controlled substance or recognized as an addictive or dangerous drug.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any state or federal statute or regulation relating to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any state or federal statute or regulation relating to controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Imposition of disciplinary action by another state or jurisdiction based on acts constituting grounds for discipline in ND
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The imposition by another state or jurisdiction of disciplinary action against a license or other authorization to practice medicine based upon acts or conduct by the physician that would constitute grounds for disciplinary action as set forth in this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lack of appropriate documentation in medical records for diagnosis, testing, and treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The lack of appropriate documentation in medical records for diagnosis, testing, and treatment of patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board or investigative panel information legally requested
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to furnish the board or the investigative panel, their investigators, or representatives information legally requested by the board or the investigative panel.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Noncompliance with the physician health program established under chapter 43-17.3
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Noncompliance with the physician health program established under chapter 43-17.3.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of medicine" includes the practice of medicine, surgery, and obstetrics.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" includes the practice of medicine, surgery, and obstetrics.

methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of medicine" includes the practice of medicine, surgery, and obstetrics.

drug_authority.value: Licensees may prescribe medications including controlled substances subject to state and federal law; must participate in the North Dakota prescription drug monitoring program when prescribing controlled substances.
drug_authority.quote: A licensee who, pursuant to this chapter, prescribes a controlled substance, as defined by North Dakota law, shall comply with all state and federal laws regarding the prescribing of a controlled substance, and shall participate in the North Dakota prescription drug monitoring program.

license_status_types.quote: The board may adopt rules to issue provisional and temporary licenses to be in effect in the interval between board meetings.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International graduates must present evidence of a degree of doctor of medicine or board-approved equivalent, completion of 24 months of postgraduate training in a US/Canadian program accredited by a national accrediting organization approved by the board, and a certificate from the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG). Graduates of osteopathic schools outside the US are not eligible.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: The applicant shall present evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has been awarded a certificate by the educational council for foreign medical graduates.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: the applicant has successfully completed one year of postgraduate training in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the board or by an accrediting body approved by the board

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as FDA-approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility; opioids may not be prescribed through telemedicine for any other purpose.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as a federal food and drug administration approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility. Opioids may not be prescribed through a telemedicine encounter for any other purpose.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: A licensee who, pursuant to this chapter, prescribes a controlled substance, as defined by North Dakota law, shall comply with all state and federal laws regarding the prescribing of a controlled substance, and shall participate in the North Dakota prescription drug monitoring program.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A licensee who has performed a telemedicine examination or evaluation meeting the requirements of this chapter may prescribe medications according to the licensee's professional discretion and judgment, except opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as FDA-approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A licensee who has performed a telemedicine examination or evaluation meeting the requirements of this chapter may prescribe medications according to the licensee's professional discretion and judgment. Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as a federal food and drug administration approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: Fees levied under subsection 1 of article XIII of the interstate medical licensure compact by the interstate medical licensure compact commission to the state of North Dakota must be paid by the board through the board's funding mechanism

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: a physician assistant with less than four thousand hours of practice approved by the board under subsection 5 shall execute a written collaborative agreement that: a. Is between a physician and a physician assistant with less than four thousand hours practice; b. Describes how collaboration required under subsection 3 must occur

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe and dispense schedule II through V controlled substances and all legend drugs; must register with the DEA if prescribing controlled substances.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: May prescribe and dispense schedule II through V substances as designated by the federal drug enforcement agency and all legend drugs

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Establish a mechanism for dealing with a licensee who abuses or is dependent upon or addicted to alcohol or other addictive chemical substances, to enter an agreement, at its discretion, with a professional organization whose relevant procedures and techniques it has evaluated and approved for the organization's cooperation or participation.
